data.raw_text:
LOOK: Enraged health workers under the banner of the Alliance of Health Workers (AHW) staged a protest in front of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) on Tuesday, September 9, shaving their heads to demand the immediate release of their long-delayed Performance-Based Bonus (PBB) for 2021 to 2023.

They said the head-shaving symbolizes their deep frustration and underscores the continued denial of their rightful benefits, long-overdue salary increases, and the persistent neglect of their rights and welfare—even as billions of pesos are funneled into confidential funds and questionable flood control projects. 

📸: Mark Balmores | MB
